reviewed: Official Jaffe–Witten CMI problem description, Section 4, printed page 6 / PDF index 5: complete problem statement and preceding positive-energy/vacuum/mass definition, extracted PDF text.
comparison: Requires a nontrivial four-dimensional theory and a positive finite physical mass. These requirements are distinguished from conditional geometric scaling bounds, one finite positive Laplace measure and a finite Markov transfer.
limits: No complete QFT reconstruction theorem, original spectral construction, continuum field or physical mass-gap proof is used. The elementary limiting and spectral bounds are presented without a general novelty claim; priority for the separate exact finite transfer comparison remains unresolved.
